items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (Unauthenticated PHP object injection)
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, allowing remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie without authentication.

items.title: Security updates for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (May 2026)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical and important vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization (CVE-2026-34646, CVE-2026-34645), server-side request forgery (CVE-2026-34647), uncontrolled resource consumption, cross-site scripting, and path traversal.

items.title: Adobe Commerce DOS Vulnerability
items.summary: A denial-of-service vulnerability in Adobe Commerce, caused by a dependency on a vulnerable third-party component, can be triggered remotely without authentication, leading to application crashes.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image, bypassing validation, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-05
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, execute arbitrary code, and access sensitive files.
